footer.tagline: CityRide ihuza abatwara moto n'abakiriya binyuze mu buryo bwizerwa, bushingiye ku mwanya.

home.heroTitle: Shaka urugendo rwegereye. Ihuze ufite icyizere.
home.heroDescription: CityRide ifasha abakiriya kubona abatwara moto bari hafi bakabahuza muburyo bworoshye, bushingiye ku mwanya.
home.sectionSubtitle: Inzira isobanutse kuva ku gushaka kugeza ku kubaza no kurenga.
home.card1Description: Abakiriya barashobora kureba abatwara moto bari hafi, bafite amakuru y'intera n'uburyo buboneka.
home.card2Description: Iyo umukiriya yikoreye Kanda, igikorwa cyo kuvugana kirabikwa kitari cyo guhitamo urugendo rwihuse.
home.card3Description: Ibisabwa by'urugendo bikurikiza uburyo bwemewe kuva ku gusabwa kugeza ku kwemerewe, kwangwa, gukomeza, kurangiza, cyangwa guhagarika.

pages.howItWorksBody: Igikorwa cyo kuvugana cyandikwa nk'icyifuzo cyo kuvugana, naho ibisabwa by'urugendo biba uruhare rushya iyo bigeze ku rwego rw'ubukurikiranire.
pages.clientsBody: Abakiriya barashobora kubona abatwara moto bari hafi, kubona amakuru yabo, no gukomeza mu nzira yo gusaba urugendo muri porogaramu ya telefoni.
pages.ridersBody: Abatwara barashobora gushiraho konti, gutanga inyandiko, gutegereza kwemezwa, no kujya online kugira ngo baboneke abakiriya bari hafi.
pages.trustBody: Kwemeza bikorwa hifashishijwe isuzuma ry'amakuru y'abatwara n'umurongo w'ubuyobozi n'ubusuzuma with pending, verified, and rejected states.
pages.faqBody: Ibibazo bibazwa mu ndimi eshatu bigamije gusobanura uburyo CityRide ikora n'amagambo y'ubukorikori.

admin.dashboardSubtitle: Kureba sisitemu ya CityRide uko ikora ukoresheje imibare y'ubushobozi n'ibisobanuro by'admin.
admin.loginDescription: Injira urebe kwemeza abatwara, ibyabaye, ibisabwa by'urugendo, n'iboneza.
admin.unauthorizedDescription: Ugomba kwinjira kugira ngo ubone agace ka admin.
